# LinkedIn Technical Marketing Post: CRM Data Decay & Contact Hygiene Engine

Deterministic contact hygiene scanner that validates corporate email domains, detects defunct company websites, and flags invalid phone numbers before sales reps waste hours.

### The Problem
Most companies lose thousands in hidden operational waste every single month.

### The Engineered Fix
We engineered a zero-dependency system to solve this.

👉 Try the live interactive simulator here:
https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/crm-data-decay-detector/
